> restaurant-sales-sync-for-quickbooks@0.1.0 test
> node --test --test-concurrency=1

✔ T-NORMALIZE: canonical input is sorted, frozen, and fingerprinted (14.6708ms)

✔ T-CURRENCY: unsupported or crossed market pairs are rejected (0.30535ms)

✔ T-JOURNAL-CA: Quebec source preserves supplied GST and QST totals (0.572424ms)

✔ T-UNBALANCED: the engine never inserts a plug line (0.537421ms)

✔ T-TIMEOUT-BEFORE-COMMIT: missing stable reference returns to safe review (1.820937ms)

✔ T-CORRECTION-RESUME: replacement failure resumes without a second reversal (3.941736ms)
✔ T-CORRECTION: later source revisions use new correction references (4.353537ms)
✔ T-EXTERNAL-EDIT: edited original blocks automatic correction (2.512701ms)
✔ T-EXTERNAL-DELETE: deleted original blocks automatic correction (1.945074ms)
✔ T-MAPPING-VERSION: approved mapping revisions never rewrite the original preview (1.535296ms)
✔ T-QB-CONTRACT and T-TOAST-CONTRACT: production adapters remain explicitly external-gated (0.434486ms)
✔ test/helpers.js (61.401635ms)

✔ T-PAYMENT-GRACE: failed payment allows seven days then blocks new writes (0.272331ms)
✔ T-LOCALE-COVERAGE: all four catalogs have key and placeholder parity (1.250056ms)
✔ T-LOCALE-IMMUTABILITY: changing display locale cannot mutate accounting data (16.469885ms)
✔ T-PERSISTENCE-RESTART: durable posting state prevents a duplicate after restart (4.515782ms)
✔ T-DELETION: external credentials revoke before primary data purge (1.186911ms)
✔ T-EXPORT: register is locale-neutral and formula-safe (0.515818ms)
